name: crip-platform
description: CRIP domain agent for PLATFORM ADMINS: Azure access review, estate-wide overview and CRIP usage.
summary: For platform admins: who has access to what, the whole estate at a glance, and who uses CRIP.

delegation_tool.name: ask_platform
delegation_tool.description: Ask the Platform agent (ONLY for users with the CRIP Platform admin role) about governance ACROSS the estate: who holds Owner / Contributor / Reader roles on a subscription (access review, guests, direct user grants, deleted identities), an overview of every subscription (month-to-date cost, secure score, Advisor counts), and CRIP's own usage log (who used CRIP, how often, what was denied). Non-admins receive an access-denied result.

examples: Who has Owner access on this subscription?
Give me an overview of all subscriptions.

tools.name: platform_access_review
tools.description: Role assignments that apply to a subscription (including inherited), with names, and findings: owner count, privileged roles granted directly to users, guests with privileged roles, assignments to deleted identities.

tools.name: platform_estate_overview
tools.description: One row per subscription in CRIP's scope: month-to-date cost, Defender secure score and Advisor recommendation counts.

tools.name: platform_crip_usage
tools.description: CRIP's own usage log: users, requests, denials and recent activity over the last N days.

days.description: Look-back window in days. Defaults to 7.
